body.name: Two-resolution bias--variance envelope
body.construction: At \(h_n=(\ell_n/n_\ast)^{1/(2s+d)}\) and \(k_n=h_n\ell_n^{-2/s}\), set \(\eta_n=k_n^{s-r}+\sqrt{\ell_n/(n_\ast k_n^{d+2r})}+\ell_n/(n_\ast k_n^{d+r})\) and \(\mathfrak R_{H,n}=C\{h_n^s+k_n^s[1+\log(1/k_n)]+\sqrt{\ell_n/(n_\ast h_n^d)}+\ell_n/[n_\ast(h_nk_n)^{d/2}]+\eta_n^2\}\).
